subject: POC credentialing playbook and next steps
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@brightlynx.ai>, Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@brightlynx.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC credentialing playbook and next steps

Hi Samira / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we provision anything for the trial: 

Summary of what we discussed
- Objective: 3-week evaluation of Redwood inference for BrightLynx feature X (throughput + cost + latency) with production-like prompts.
- Success criteria (draft): average p95 latency < 450ms for 1k token sessions, cost per 1k tokens <$8 under the suggested batching profile, and parity on output quality for 6 canonical prompts (you + product will confirm).

What we need from BrightLynx to start provisioning (please confirm owners):
1) Security/IT contact who can add Redwood API egress IPs to your allowlist (Tom?) — we will provide IP ranges and template.
2) SSO/Okta admin to approve two SSO test accounts (product owner + engineering lead).
3) A staging workspace owner for eval data and success metric collection.

Redwood will provide:
- An ephemeral staging API key scoped to the trial
- Onboarding checklist & configuration template (we'll attach and share Drive link)
- A small test harness you can run against your canonical prompts to produce the metrics above

Proposed timeline
- This week (Nov 3–6): agree success criteria, provide IT contact and SSO admin, complete allowlist template
- Week of Nov 9: Redwood provisions API key + SSO invites; Evelyn will run first smoke tests with your team
- Week of Nov 16: full-run evaluation, data collection, and a 30-minute review with product + eng to confirm go/no-go

Immediate asks (can we confirm by EOD Thursday?):
- Confirm that the success criteria above reflect your internal priorities and which prompts you want in the canonical set
- Confirm IT contact for allowlisting and SSO admin names/emails

I'll attach our onboarding checklist and the allowlist CSV template in my next note. Evelyn (cc) will add technical details on required payloads and recommended batching.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0183

From: Samira Khan <samira@brightlynx.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@brightlynx.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC credentialing playbook and next steps

Thanks Marcus — this lines up with our expectations. Quick responses inline below: 

Success criteria
- Confirmed: p95 latency and cost targets are right. We'll add a qualitative pass on the 6 prompts (we'll share the prompt list by Thursday).

Owners
- IT contact: Tom Ruiz (tom.ruiz@brightlynx.ai) — he'll handle allowlist and network config.
- SSO admin: I manage our Okta team for this POC but will add our SSO admin (it@brightlynx.ai) to the invite once you share details.

Allowlist
- Tom, our egress policy requires IP/CIDR entries and an expected maintenance window for changes. The ranges you provide will need a short justification and estimated duration.

Credentials
- We prefer an ephemeral staging API key and a separate long-lived service account if the POC goes green. Please scope the staging key to only the test workspace.

Data retention / logs question
- What's Redwood's default retention window for request/response logs in the staging environment? We need that for our security checklist.

Timing
- The week-of-Nov-9 window for provisioning works for us. Please flag any earlier constraints.

I'll also attach a vCard for our IT admin (tom.ruiz@brightlynx.ai) to this thread.

Samira Khan
Director, ML Platform | BrightLynx
samira@brightlynx.ai | +1 (617) 444-9922

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@brightlynx.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@brightlynx.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 13:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: POC credentialing playbook and next steps

Hi team — jumping in with the technical plan so your engineers have clarity. 

Tech checklist (high level)
- SSO: Redwood supports SAML 2.0/Okta. For the POC we only need a group mapping for two users and a service account. Please share the Okta org URL and the admin invite email (it@brightlynx.ai).
- API key: we will issue an ephemeral key scoped to a single workspace; it will be valid for 30 days by default. If you want a shorter TTL we can do 7 days.
- IP allowlist: we recommend adding the range we provide and mark it as only for staging. We will supply the exact CIDRs and a one-line justification for your change ticket.
- Metrics harness: run our small harness (loads of 100 sessions, recommended concurrency 4) against your canonical prompts. Expect an initial KV cache warm-up period; exclude first 50 sessions from the latency SLA calculation.

Configuration recommendations
- Quantization/profile: start with the 'balanced' profile in the attached redwood_poc_config_template.yaml — it gives a good tradeoff between throughput and quality for 1k token sessions.
- Batching: set continuous batching to 32ms and target batch sizes of ~8 for the initial run. We can tweak once we see sample traces.

I've attached a configuration template (redwood_poc_config_template.yaml) and will add the Drive folder with the harness and a small notebook that computes the success metrics. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPOCconfig

Evelyn Hart
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
evelyn@redwood.com

From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@brightlynx.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@brightlynx.ai>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: POC credentialing playbook and next steps

Hi all — security follow-up from my side. We'll provision the artifacts once we have the confirmed owners and the allowlist details. Action items and notes: 

1) API key provisioning
- I'll generate a scoped staging key with a 30-day TTL and limited scopes (read/generate). If you prefer 7 days, tell me in reply and we'll shorten it. The key will be pushed into your team's secure vault via the DocuSign secure recipient flow (link below) unless you prefer a different secret transfer method.

2) SSO invites
- Please add dev@brightlynx.ai to your Okta admin console (or tell us the email to invite). We'll send SAML metadata and a guided setup doc.

3) IP allowlist
- Tom: please fill out the attached ip_allowlist_template.csv with the ticket/justification and the intended maintenance window. Once we receive it we can provide the exact CIDRs.

4) Data retention
- For staging environments Redwood retains request/response logs for 30 days by default (configurable). We can redact inputs on ingestion if you need shorter retention; we can discuss the exact policy during the SOC/infosec review.

Attachments included:
- redwood_poc_onboarding_checklist.pdf (onboarding steps and contact points)
- ip_allowlist_template.csv (CSV template to populate for your change ticket)
- redwood_poc_config_template.yaml (Evelyn included, attached here for convenience)

DocuSign secure transfer (for the staging key): https://www.docusign.com/recipient/12345abcdef

I'll wait for the completed allowlist template and the Okta admin email to schedule provisioning.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Security Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
